title: takeover: a full-frame title card that removes him mid-cut, with a red/cyan split flicker and a light streak
goal:
From the AI music cut. Build device `takeover` for a graphics-only STAGE beat: a full-frame title card in the display role that arrives with a 3-frame red/cyan channel-split flicker (offset copies in tokens.channel and tokens.mint only, never raw red or cyan hex) and a single light streak across it, then holds. Verbs: enter, exit. Test: the flicker frames and the streak's single pass.

Per devices/CONTRACT.md: index.tsx, state.ts, schema.ts, fixture.json, device.test.ts; register in registry.ts and config/ve/devices.json.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. Every number carries its producer. In a layout region (kit/layout.ts isRegion, kit/staging.ts) the device lays out at its natural size and grows to fill the region (kit/regionFit.tsx).
acceptance:
